subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Drop me a message when __the food will be ready__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option(4) i.e. "the food is ready"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The future tense **"will be" **is not used in time clauses like** "when," "after," "before,"** etc.** Instead, the present simple tense** is used to refer to **future events** within these clauses, making** "the food is ready" **correct.
 
• "The food is ready" simplifies and corrects the temporal reference, ensuring clarity and grammatical accuracy in indicating when the action (dropping a message) should take place.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is- "Drop me a message when the food is ready__."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ("the food will be prepared") also uses future tense incorrectly in the time clause and alters the original meaning slightly.
 
• Option 2 ("the food will ready") is grammatically incorrect due to the omission of "be," and it repeats the mistake of using future tense in a time clause.
 
• Option 3 ("the food shall be ready") also inaccurately uses future tense in a time clause.
